title: Release consolidation weekly scrub and hotpath notes
summary: This doc captures the weekly scrub for the current release train plus a focused hotpath play for a recent inference-serving timeout spike. Primary goals: validate pre-rollout checklist for 2.3.1, confirm hotfix lifecycle for 2.3.0 -> 2.3.0-hotfix1, and lock owners for change windows and rollback criteria.
content:
Attendees: Maya (notes), Diego, Priya, Samir, Evelyn, on-call rotation: week B.

Meeting context / goal:
- Weekly consolidation scrub for release train 2.3.x cadence. We are prepping micro rollouts for 2.3.1 (scheduled next Wednesday) and verifying that the hotfix for 2.3.0 timeout regression is safe to proceed as 2.3.0-hotfix1.
- Short hotpath review: root-cause hypotheses and canary metric thresholds for automated abort.

Quick status snapshot:
- 2.3.1 release branch: feature-freeze achieved, integration tests green on linux/gpu matrix (95% pass), flaky test gating: infra/job-scheduler-timeouts.
- 2.3.0-hotfix1: currently staged on staging cluster stg-a; hotfix addresses kv-cache bug introduced in 2.3.0 that causes server-side timeouts under sustained bursty traffic.
- Capacity: Dedicated pool alpha has 120 GPUs reserved; projected steady-state qps supports 2.3.1 at 70% utilization with current batching settings.

Hotfix deep-dive (2.3.0-hotfix1):
- Symptom: periodic 504s from model-proxy when prefix cache eviction collided with in-flight KV fetches. Seen in prod from 2026-03-05 02:10 to 02:42 UTC.
- Repro: small load harness reproduces 2–4% elevated p95 and occasional 504s when sequence lengths skew > 1.5x baseline. Repro steps in linked PR.
- Fix: add locking around kv-evict + metric guard to prevent concurrent cache invalidation while request in flight; also a short cooldown backoff.
- Canary plan: rollout to 2% of traffic in region us-west1 for 1 hour, evaluate: p95 latency delta <= +5ms, error rate delta <= +0.1%, no increase in tail memory. Abort conditions: error rate > +0.5% OR p95 > +30ms OR new 5xx class > 0.1% absolute.
- Rollback: hotfix will auto-fallback to 2.3.0 if abort triggers; manual rollback instructions: follow runbook section RB-2 in CONFLUENCE-RELEASES-2.3.

Pre-rollout checklist for 2.3.1 (owners):
- Verify performance profile matrix (Samir) — done except nvTX trace on xformers config (due 2026-03-12).
- Security review sign-off (Evelyn) — keys rotation check OK, KMS integration doc update pending.
- SRE capacity bump config (Diego) — autoscaler min bump tested; metrics look stable.
- Dependency gating: third-party tokenizer lib pinned to 0.9.4 (PR merged), confirm container CVE scan (Priya).

Change window and communication:
- Primary window: 2026-03-18 03:00 - 06:00 UTC (low traffic).
- Notify channels: #release-ops, #oncall, SRE pager. Email to customers with Dedicated contracts sent 48h prior.
- Observability hooks: enable tracing sample rate 1% -> 5% for first 30m post-rollout, and enable structured eval prompts for canary requests.

Decision logs from meeting:
- Approve hotfix canary to go ahead on staging -> prod canary per thresholds above (vote: unanimous).
- Defer non-blocking perf improvements in 2.3.1 to patch 2.3.2 to avoid scope creep.
- Keep rollback cold path documented and test it during next dry run on Friday 2026-03-13.

Open risks and mitigations:
- Risk: unusual GC pressure if cooldown not tuned; mitigation: memory trace enabled and autoscaling upper bound set to +15%. Owner: Samir.
- Risk: cascading fallbacks might redirect too much traffic to legacy runtime causing headroom exhaustion; mitigation: set routing cap 10% for legacy runtime during rollout and monitor headroom. Owner: Diego.
- Risk: customer dedicated pools with older drivers may not accept 2.3.1; mitigation: targeted canary exclusion list for legacy pools and manual upgrade schedule. Owner: Evelyn.

Action items (owner / due):
- Samir: finish nvTX trace and attach perf diff to CONFLUENCE-RELEASES-2.3 (due 2026-03-12).
- Priya: run final container CVE scan and post report to #release-ops (due 2026-03-12 EOD).
- Diego: configure canary throttles and autoscaler bump in staging, run smoke blast (due 2026-03-13).
- Maya: coordinate customer notification for Dedicated customers and publish weekly digest (due 2026-03-16).
- Evelyn: run rollback dry-run and confirm rollback checklist is complete (due 2026-03-13).

Notes / scratch thoughts:
- Consider adding a temporary adaptive cache guard that increments cooldown based on recent eviction rate instead of static backoff — prototype in infra-experiments branch.
- We should capture a short post-canary writeup summarizing metrics, notable spikes, and any remediation actions (owner: Maya).

Next sync:
- Quick follow-up standup Friday 2026-03-13 09:00 PT to confirm dry-run results and finalize canary window. Full release readiness review Monday 2026-03-16 16:00 UTC.

Attachments / refs: JIRA RLE-1147 (hotfix), GH PR 281 (kv cache lock + tests), CONFLUENCE-RELEASES-2.3 (release plan).
